description: Test suite for the CordRepBtreeReader class in the Abseil library, testing reading, skipping, seeking, and reading exhaustively from a CordRepBtree data structure.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Tests the Next() method of CordRepBtreeReader, verifying sequential reading of data chunks.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Tests the Skip() method, verifying skipping over data chunks.

methods.name: SkipBeyondLength
methods.description: Tests skipping beyond the total length, expecting empty result.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Tests the Seek() method, verifying seeking to specific positions within the data.

methods.name: SeekBeyondLength
methods.description: Tests seeking beyond the data length, expecting empty result.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Tests the Read() method with various parameters, verifying correct data extraction.

methods.name: ReadExhaustive
methods.description: Performs exhaustive testing of the Read() method with various read sizes.
